# ModelC

> **Kind:** component · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/renderer/model/`](../folders/src-renderer-model.md)
> **Source:** [`src/renderer/model/model.h`](../../../src/renderer/model/model.h)

## Summary

GPU mesh of one loaded glTF file (or code-built mesh), on its own entity; instances reference it through ModelRenderable::model.

## Description

Created only by ModelManager::load (from loadGLTF) and ModelManager::add, each on a fresh entity that holds nothing else. Vertices/indices are uploaded through Transfer::createBuffer (on a dedicated GPU a staging copy recorded in the transfer command buffer; ready after the transfer fence), with all glTF node transforms of the default scene baked in, so one ModelC is one vertex buffer + one uint32 index buffer split into parts by material. materials always ends with a default material (white, untextured) for primitives without one. Material::set starts null and is filled by ModelPass::update on the main thread; parts whose material has no set are skipped when drawing. min/max are the model-space bounds of all vertices. Read by ModelPass and by base_scene / world_view code (bounds). Renderer::finish removes every ModelC (reg.clear<ModelC>) before the device is destroyed; the entities themselves are not destroyed.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vertices` | `std::shared_ptr<VmaBuffer>` | null | ModelVertex buffer (position, normal, uv: 32 bytes each). |
| `indices` | `std::shared_ptr<VmaBuffer>` | null | uint32 index buffer, triangles; winding flipped for negative-determinant node transforms. |
| `parts` | `std::vector<ModelC::Part>` | empty | Draw ranges: first_index, index_count (multiple of 3), material index. |
| `materials` | `std::vector<ModelC::Material>` | empty | base_color (vec4, default 1), image (shared_ptr<VmaImage>, null = white), set (vk::DescriptorSet, filled by ModelPass). |
| `min` | `glm::vec3` | (0,0,0) | Model-space bounding box minimum. |
| `max` | `glm::vec3` | (0,0,0) | Model-space bounding box maximum. |

## Side effects per system

- **[ModelManager](../systems/ModelManager.md)**
  - creates one entity per loaded model
- **[ModelPass](../systems/ModelPass.md)**
  - allocates descriptor sets from a 1024-set pool
  - creates image views
  - records drawIndexed per part
- **[Renderer](../systems/Renderer.md)**
  - frees model GPU buffers and images
